title: decision — one settled entry
description:
A choice made during the session, worth carrying forward. SETTLED (past tense): it carries provenance — `tier`, and `evidence` unless authored — and never a lease; a decision does not expire, it gets superseded. Same grounding rule as thread.json: `derived` and `interpreted` entries must quote the transcript turn they came from and finalize rejects a quote that is not a substring of it. Same carry rule: `origin_sid8` + byte-identity (S1: `content_sha256`); same identity rule (S2: `id`, `supersedes`).

The fixture and the field set are shed's — `text` is the decision. hololoom_mcp's /handoff skill writes decisions as bare strings; shed rejects those at finalize because a string cannot say who stands behind it.

text.description: The decision, in one or two sentences, readable outside the session.

gloss.description: Free prose about the decision — never gated, always rendered as the entry's tier. `text` must be a verbatim span of the cited turn; the writer's own words go here.

evidence.description: Required on derived / interpreted entries: the transcript turn (index or uuid). `text` must be a verbatim substring of that turn; `quote` is optional and, when present, must be a substring too.

origin_sid8.description: Set when carried from an earlier archive; the entry must be byte-identical to one there.

content_sha256.description: S1: sha256 of the source entry's canonical JSON minus `origin_sid8` / `content_sha256`.

supersedes.description: S2: the decision this one reverses or refines, and why.
